tagline: Raster illustrations to clean, editable SVG. Everything stays on this computer.
privacy: Works offline · your photos never leave this computer
noToken: This page needs the link printed by "png2svg serve" (it contains the session key). Open that link again.
addBody: Drag pictures here or choose them from your computer. You can add many at once — nothing is processed until you press Process.
formats: PNG, WebP or JPEG · up to 50 MB each
pickHint: Untick the ones you want to leave for later.
failedHelp: This photo couldn't be converted. Try another style or run it again.
speedHelp_auto: Picked for this computer: {mode} ({n} at a time).
speedHelp_saver: One photo at a time with low priority — your computer stays smooth.
speedHelp_balanced: Two photos at a time on capable computers ({n} here).
speedHelp_fast: Up to {n} photos at a time. Best when you are not using the computer for anything else.
styleNote: Used for the photos you process next.
desc_logo: Straight edges, one path per shape
selectHint: Pick a finished photo on the left to compare it here. Scroll to zoom, drag to move.
notReady: The SVG appears here when it is done.
waitingHere: This photo is waiting in line. It will appear here when it is done.
t_added: {n} photo(s) added. Choose which ones to process.
t_queued: {n} photo(s) are in line. You can keep working.
t_allDone: All done — {n} photo(s) ready to save.
err_tooLarge: “{name}” is too big. Use a photo under 50 MB and at most 8000 px wide.
err_notImage: “{name}” is not a PNG, WebP or JPEG photo.
err_full: The workbench is full (100 photos). Process or remove some first.
err_offline: Can't reach the converter. Close the app and open it again.
err_generic: Something went wrong{name}. Please try again. ({detail})
confirmStopBody: Photos waiting in line are taken out. Finished results stay.
tour1_body: Turn pictures into clean, editable SVG files. Everything happens on this computer. Here is a quick tour.
tour2_body: Drag photos anywhere into this window or press Choose photos. Add as many as you like — nothing is processed yet.
tour3_body: Tick the photos you want, then pick a style: Cartoon for drawings, Logo for flat graphics, and so on.
tour4_body: Photos wait in line and are converted one after another, so your computer stays responsive. Change the speed here.
tour5_body: Slide between the original and the SVG, zoom in, then save one or all results. You can open this guide again from Guide.
themeHint: “Match system” uses Paper & ink when your computer is light and Lightbox when it is dark.
maxSideHint: Bigger photos are refused with an explanation. Lower it on computers with little memory.
maxStagedHint: How many photos can wait at the same time.
saveFolderNone: Not chosen — the app asks each time
askEachTime: Ask where to save each time
decimalsHint: Fewer decimals make smaller files; more keep tiny details. Used for photos you process next.
sizeAttrs: Add width and height to the SVG
sizeAttrsHint: Off: only a viewBox, so the SVG scales to whatever holds it.
memoryOnly: Photos and results live only in this app’s memory and are gone when you close it. Nothing is uploaded anywhere.
diagLogHint: A small text file with error messages only, never images. Applies after the app restarts.
updateNoRelease: No release has been published yet.
updateFailed: Couldn’t check right now. Try again later.
updateNote: Only when you press the button, the app asks GitHub for the latest version number. Nothing else is sent.
closeConfirm: {n} photo(s) are still waiting or being processed. Close the app and stop them?
aiHint: An AI model cleans and enlarges the photo first, so edges come out smoother — best for small or blurry pictures and JPEGs. Takes longer.
aiAutoHint: Automatic: only for photos smaller than 1000 px or JPEGs.
aiModelDesc_illustration: Best for drawings, cartoons and flat art. Recommended.
aiModelDesc_general: For photos and mixed pictures. Makes larger files.
aiNeedsModel: Download an AI model in Settings → Processing to use this.
aiUnavailable: AI enhancement is not available on this computer.
aiDownloadNote: Downloaded once from this project’s GitHub page, checked, and kept on this computer. After that it works offline.
aiFailedNetwork: The download failed. Check the internet connection and try again.
aiFailedChecksum: The downloaded file was not the expected one and was removed. Try again later.
aiGpuNone: No supported graphics card found; the processor is used.
paletteRemove: Remove this color (its areas take the nearest color)
paletteHint: Every area takes the nearest of these colors. Click a color to change it; remove one to merge it into the nearest.
t_paletteLocked: Palette locked — edit it under Fine-tune, then process again.
layoutHint: Stacked: smallest files. Cut out: shapes never overlap — for cutting machines and editing.
profileSave: Save the current style as a profile
profileExport: Export the style as a file
profileInvalid: This file is not a valid style profile ({detail}).
formatHint_svg: Editable vector for the web, Figma, Illustrator, Inkscape.
formatHint_pdf: Vector PDF with real gradients — print, documents, Illustrator.
formatHint_eps: Vector EPS for print shops and older design tools.
formatHint_dxf: Outlines for CAD, laser and plotters (one layer per color, no fills).
formatHint_png: Sharp picture at any size, drawn from the vector.
saveAllNoPng: Save all works for SVG, PDF, EPS and DXF.
t_pngScaled: The picture was too large; saved at {s}× instead.
layoutHint_centerline: Center lines: line drawings become one stroke along the middle of each line, without fills — for plotters, laser and embroidery. The threshold sets what counts as ink.
editHint: Click a shape in the vector to select it.
editPickHint: Now click the shape whose color to use.
watchHint: Pictures that appear in the watched folder (after you press Start) are converted with the current style and saved in the results folder. They also show up in the queue.
watchStyle: Uses the current style: {style} (with your fine-tune choices).
watchCli: Without the app: png2svg watch IN OUT --profile style.pngsvg-profile.json
opt_split_shapes: Split shapes joined by a thin neck
flatHint: Logo engine: one path per shape, straight edges, sharp corners, no background.
notFlatLogo: This picture has shading or many colors — the Cartoon or Flat illustration style keeps more detail.
